hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; s="$d/scripts/hook-git-guard.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || s="$d/harness/scripts/hook-git-guard.py"; if [ -f "$s" ]; then exec python3 "$s"; else cat >/dev/null; echo "hook-git-guard: NOT FOUND under $d — the git guard is not running" >&2; echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) hook-git-guard MISSING under $d" >> /tmp/harness-hook-events.log; fi

GATE_WORKTREE="$WORKTREE_PATH"; echo "HOOK: WorktreeRemove — path=${GATE_WORKTREE:-unset} at $(date -u +%FT%TZ)" >> /tmp/harness-hook-events.log; broker_pid=$(ps -eo pid=,command= | grep 'app-server-broker.mjs' | grep -- "--cwd $GATE_WORKTREE" | awk '{print $1}'); [ -n "$broker_pid" ] && kill "$broker_pid" 2>/dev/null; proj=$(basename "$GATE_WORKTREE" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | sed 's/[^a-z0-9_-]//g'); ids=$(docker ps -q --filter "label=com.docker.compose.project=$proj" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$ids" ]; then docker stop $ids || echo "WARN: docker stop failed for compose project $proj"; else echo "NOTE: no container labelled com.docker.compose.project=$proj — this worktree started none"; fi

d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; s="$d/scripts/hook-contract-reload.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || s="$d/harness/scripts/hook-contract-reload.py"; if [ -f "$s" ]; then exec python3 "$s"; else cat >/dev/null; echo "hook-contract-reload: NOT FOUND under $d — role contracts are not re-armed after compaction" >&2; echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) hook-contract-reload MISSING under $d" >> /tmp/harness-hook-events.log; fi

payload=$(cat); agent_type=$(echo "$payload" | grep -o '"agent_type":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4); agent_id=$(echo "$payload" | grep -o '"agent_id":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4); session_id=$(echo "$payload" | grep -o '"session_id":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4); echo "HOOK: SubagentStop — type=${agent_type:-unknown} id=${agent_id:-unknown} session=${session_id:-unknown} payload_size=${#payload} exited" >> /tmp/harness-hook-events.log
